occurrences.quote: Claim to verify: A Yakshagana artist combines dance, costum, makeup, and dialogue. The author who wrote the novel Marali Mannige in 2000 is this kind of artist.
The passages do not provide evidence to support the claim that K. Shivaram Karanth, the author of "Marali Mannige," is a Yakshagana artist.

[[ ## summary ## ]]
The claim cannot be verified based on the provided passages. While the passages confirm that "Marali Mannige" is a Kannada novel by K. Shivaram Karanth and provide a definition of Yakshagana as an art form combining dance, costume, makeup, and dialogue, they do not establish any connection between K. Shivaram Karanth and Yakshagana.
